component.name: WorkerTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "drain" m.inTask = false m.count = 0 m.last = 0 m.inversions = 0 m.portCount = 0 end sub
' XML onChange on the task thread that waits on the port observing the same field. sub onReq(event as object) v = event.getData() if v <= 2 then print "ONCHANGE v=" + v.toStr() + " inTask=" + m.inTask.toStr() if not m.inTask then return if v < m.last then m.inversions++ m.last = v m.count++ msg = wait(1, m.port) if type(msg) = "roSGNodeEvent" then m.portCount++ end sub
sub drain() m.port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") m.top.observeField("request", m.port) m.inTask = true m.top.ready = true idle = 0 while idle < 20 msg = wait(100, m.port) if type(msg) = "roSGNodeEvent" idle = 0 m.portCount++ else idle++ end if end while m.top.report = "onChange n=" + m.count.toStr() + " inversions=" + m.inversions.toStr() + " | port n=" + m.portCount.toStr() + " | final field=" + m.top.request.toStr() end sub
